upgrades.title: Quickened Words I
upgrades.description: Add 20% of base phrase frequency. Each phrase keeps its current conviction.

upgrades.title: Compelling Creed I
upgrades.description: Add 0.5 conviction to each phrase. Speaking rhythm stays the same.

upgrades.title: Fleet Footsteps I
upgrades.description: Add 15% of base running speed. Speaking and conviction stay the same.

upgrades.title: Quickened Words II
upgrades.description: Add another 20% of base phrase frequency.

upgrades.title: Compelling Creed II
upgrades.description: Add another 0.5 conviction to each phrase.

upgrades.title: Fleet Footsteps II
upgrades.description: Add another 15% of base running speed.

upgrades.title: Quickened Words III
upgrades.description: Rank 1 adds 20% of base phrase frequency; rank 2 adds 30%. Conviction per phrase stays the same.

upgrades.title: Compelling Creed III
upgrades.description: Each rank adds 0.5 conviction per phrase. Overflow still carries to the next listener.

upgrades.title: Fleet Footsteps III
upgrades.description: Each rank adds 15% of base running speed. Speaking frequency and conviction stay the same.
